---
title: "mitRix cohort report"
date: "`r format(Sys.time(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')`"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    self_contained: true
params:
  cohort: ""
  metadata: ""
  subtype_col: "disease"
  covariates: "age,sex,batch"
  keep_flagged: false
  adjusted_out: ""
  mitrix_version: ""
  outdir: ""
  annotation: ""
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 8, fig.height = 4.5, dpi = 110)
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(ggplot2))
theme_set(theme_bw(base_size = 11))
set.seed(42)
kable <- function(x, ...) knitr::kable(x, format = "html", ...) |> kableExtra_free()
kableExtra_free <- function(x) structure(x, class = c("knit_asis", class(x)))
# backtick-quote names that are not syntactic (e.g. the 7S column) for formulas
bt <- function(x) ifelse(make.names(x) == x, x, paste0("`", x, "`"))
fmt_p <- function(p) ifelse(is.na(p), NA, formatC(p, digits = 2, format = "g"))
has_glmnet <- requireNamespace("glmnet", quietly = TRUE)
has_uwot   <- requireNamespace("uwot", quietly = TRUE)

cohort <- read.delim(params$cohort, colClasses = "character", na.strings = "NA", check.names = FALSE)
meta   <- read.delim(params$metadata, colClasses = "character", na.strings = c("NA", ""), check.names = FALSE)
stopifnot("sample" %in% names(meta))

# readouts: numeric cohort columns except QC ones
qc_cols  <- c("sample", "qc_flag", "contamination", "contamination_level",
              "haplogroup", "macro_haplogroup", "cn_cluster", "cn_cluster_prob")
readouts <- setdiff(names(cohort), qc_cols)
for (r in c(readouts, "contamination_level")) if (r %in% names(cohort)) cohort[[r]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(cohort[[r]]))
readouts <- readouts[vapply(readouts, function(r) any(!is.na(cohort[[r]])), logical(1))]

in_both   <- intersect(cohort$sample, meta$sample)
no_meta   <- setdiff(cohort$sample, meta$sample)
no_cohort <- setdiff(meta$sample, cohort$sample)
d <- merge(cohort, meta, by = "sample")

covars <- intersect(strsplit(params$covariates, ",")[[1]], names(meta))
num_meta <- function(x) { y <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x)); if (sum(!is.na(y)) == sum(!is.na(x))) y else factor(x) }
for (m in setdiff(names(meta), "sample")) d[[m]] <- num_meta(d[[m]])
subtype <- if (params$subtype_col %in% names(d)) params$subtype_col else NA
if (!is.na(subtype)) d[[subtype]] <- factor(d[[subtype]])

# qc_flag tokens: "column:low_depth" only sets that column to NA for the sample (the
# heteroplasmy module's low-HF metrics at low chrM depth); any other token excludes it
soft_flags <- c("low_depth", "uncertain")   # cn_cluster:uncertain only blanks cn_cluster
tokens <- strsplit(d$qc_flag, ";", fixed = TRUE)
soft_na <- 0L
for (i in seq_len(nrow(d))) for (t in tokens[[i]]) {
  col <- sub(":.*", "", t)
  if (grepl(":", t) && sub("^[^:]*:", "", t) %in% soft_flags && col %in% names(d)) {
    d[[col]][i] <- NA; soft_na <- soft_na + 1L
  }
}
flagged <- vapply(tokens, function(t) any(t != "PASS" & !(grepl(":", t) & sub("^[^:]*:", "", t) %in% soft_flags)), logical(1))
a <- if (isTRUE(params$keep_flagged)) d else d[!flagged, , drop = FALSE]
```

**mitrix `r params$mitrix_version`** · cohort `r params$cohort` · metadata `r params$metadata`

## QC summary

```{r qc}
qc <- data.frame(
  item  = c("Samples in cohort table", "Samples in metadata", "In both (analysed set before QC)",
            "In cohort, no metadata", "In metadata, not in cohort",
            "Flagged (qc_flag not PASS)", "Used in analyses",
            "Values set to NA (low_depth: low-HF heteroplasmy at low chrM depth)"),
  n     = c(nrow(cohort), nrow(meta), length(in_both), length(no_meta), length(no_cohort),
            sum(flagged), nrow(a), soft_na))
kable(qc, col.names = c("", "n"))
```

`r if (length(no_cohort)) paste("Not in cohort:", paste(no_cohort, collapse = ", "))`

```{r qc-flags, results = "asis"}
if (any(flagged)) {
  cat(if (isTRUE(params$keep_flagged)) "Flagged samples are **kept** (`--keep-flagged`):\n\n"
      else "Flagged samples are **excluded** from the analyses below:\n\n")
  print(kable(d[flagged, c("sample", "qc_flag")], row.names = FALSE))
} else cat("No samples flagged.\n")
```

```{r distributions, fig.height = 2.6 * ceiling(length(readouts) / 3)}
  data.frame(sample = a$sample, readout = r, value = a[[r]],
             group = if (!is.na(subtype)) a[[subtype]] else "all")))
ggplot(long, aes(group, value, colour = group)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) + geom_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0) +
  facet_wrap(~readout, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, colour = if (!is.na(subtype)) subtype else NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r summary-table}

  x <- a[[r]]
  data.frame(readout = r, n = sum(!is.na(x)), mean = signif(mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
             sd = signif(sd(x, na.rm = TRUE), 3), median = signif(median(x, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
             min = signif(min(x, na.rm = TRUE), 4), max = signif(max(x, na.rm = TRUE), 4))
}))
kable(st, row.names = FALSE)
```

## Correlation between readouts

Spearman correlation, pairwise complete.

```{r correlation, fig.width = 6, fig.height = 5}
cm <- cor(a[readouts], method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
cl <- as.data.frame(as.table(cm))
ggplot(cl, aes(Var1, Var2, fill = Freq)) + geom_tile() +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", Freq)), size = 3.5) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(limits = c(-1, 1), low = "#3b6fb6", high = "#c0392b", mid = "white") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "rho") + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

## Batch adjustment and z-scores

```{r adjust, results = "asis"}
adj <- a[c("sample", readouts)]
if ("batch" %in% names(a) && nlevels(droplevels(factor(a$batch))) > 1) {
  for (r in readouts) {
    fit <- lm(a[[r]] ~ factor(a$batch), na.action = na.exclude)
    adj[[r]] <- residuals(fit) + mean(a[[r]], na.rm = TRUE)
  }
  cat("Each readout is adjusted for batch (linear model; batch effect removed, overall mean kept).\n\n")
} else cat("No `batch` column with more than one level: no batch adjustment.\n\n")
z <- adj; for (r in readouts) z[[r]] <- as.numeric(scale(adj[[r]]))
out <- a[c("sample", readouts)]
for (r in readouts) { out[[paste0(r, "_adj")]] <- adj[[r]]; out[[paste0(r, "_z")]] <- z[[r]] }
if (nzchar(params$adjusted_out)) {
  write.table(out, params$adjusted_out, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, na = "NA")
  cat(sprintf("Raw, adjusted (`_adj`) and z-scored (`_z`) values: `%s`.\n", params$adjusted_out))
}
```

## Covariate associations

Each readout regressed on each covariate, adjusted for the other covariates in
`r paste(covars, collapse = ", ")` where present. Numeric covariates: slope; categorical:
F-test across levels. FDR (Benjamini–Hochberg) over the whole table.

```{r assoc}
assoc_vars <- unique(c(covars, if (!is.na(subtype)) subtype))
res <- do.call(rbind, lapply(readouts, function(r) do.call(rbind, lapply(assoc_vars, function(v) {
  adj_for <- setdiff(covars, v)
  dd <- a[c(r, v, adj_for)]; dd <- dd[complete.cases(dd), , drop = FALSE]
  dd <- dd[, c(TRUE, vapply(dd[-1], function(x) length(unique(x)) > 1, logical(1))), drop = FALSE]
  if (!(v %in% names(dd)) || nrow(dd) < ncol(dd) + 2) return(NULL)
  f <- reformulate(bt(setdiff(names(dd), r)), response = bt(r))
  fit <- lm(f, data = dd); an <- drop1(fit, test = "F")
  est <- if (is.numeric(dd[[v]])) signif(coef(fit)[[bt(v)]], 3) else NA
  data.frame(readout = r, covariate = v, n = nrow(dd), effect = est, p = an[bt(v), "Pr(>F)"])
}))))
if (!is.null(res) && nrow(res)) {
  res$FDR <- p.adjust(res$p, "BH"); res <- res[order(res$p), ]
  res$p <- fmt_p(res$p); res$FDR <- fmt_p(res$FDR)
  kable(res, row.names = FALSE)
} else cat("Not enough data for covariate models.\n")
```

## Readouts by haplogroup

```{r haplo, results = "asis", fig.height = 2.6 * ceiling(length(readouts) / 3)}
if ("macro_haplogroup" %in% names(a) && any(!is.na(a$macro_haplogroup))) {
  print(kable(as.data.frame(table(macro_haplogroup = a$macro_haplogroup)), row.names = FALSE))
  lh <- do.call(rbind, lapply(readouts, function(r)
    data.frame(readout = r, value = a[[r]], hg = a$macro_haplogroup)))
  print(ggplot(lh, aes(hg, value)) + geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
          geom_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0) + facet_wrap(~readout, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
          labs(x = "macro-haplogroup", y = NULL))
  kw <- do.call(rbind, lapply(readouts, function(r) {
    ok <- !is.na(a[[r]]) & !is.na(a$macro_haplogroup)
    if (length(unique(a$macro_haplogroup[ok])) < 2) return(NULL)
    data.frame(readout = r, p_kruskal = fmt_p(kruskal.test(a[[r]][ok], factor(a$macro_haplogroup[ok]))$p.value))
  }))
  if (!is.null(kw)) print(kable(kw, row.names = FALSE))
} else cat("No haplogroup data.\n")
```

## Heteroplasmy spectrum and function

```{r het-load, include = FALSE}
het_file <- function(s) file.path(params$outdir, s, "heteroplasmy", paste0(s, ".heteroplasmy.variants.tsv"))
hv <- if (nzchar(params$outdir)) do.call(rbind, lapply(a$sample, function(s)
  if (file.exists(het_file(s))) read.delim(het_file(s), colClasses = "character", na.strings = ".")))
has_het <- !is.null(hv) && nrow(hv) > 0
if (has_het) {
  hv$hf <- as.numeric(hv$hf)
  if (!is.na(subtype)) hv$group <- a[[subtype]][match(hv$sample, a$sample)] else hv$group <- "all"
}
```

```{r het-spectrum, results = "asis", eval = has_het, fig.height = 3.5}
cat("Heteroplasmic SNVs pooled over the analysed samples. Strand: rCRS REF C/A = light (L),",
    "G/T = heavy (H), written as the complement (Gupta et al., Nature 2026).",
    "Age-accumulating: H C>T, H A>G and L A>G outside chrM:16172-210.\n\n")
sn <- hv[!is.na(hv$strand), ]
sn$class <- paste(sn$strand, sn$substitution)
print(ggplot(sn, aes(class, fill = hf_bin)) + geom_bar() + facet_wrap(~group) +
        labs(x = NULL, y = "heteroplasmic SNVs", fill = "HF bin") +
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1)))
rt <- as.data.frame.matrix(table(region = ifelse(is.na(hv$region), "NA", hv$region), hf_bin = hv$hf_bin))
print(kable(rt, caption = "Heteroplasmies by region and HF bin"))
```

```{r het-dnds, results = "asis", eval = has_het}
# crude dN/dS: (observed / possible) nonsynonymous over synonymous SNVs, possible counts
# from presets/mt_annotation.tsv.gz, excluding the MT-ATP8/ATP6 overlap (8527-8572);
# not weighted by the mutation spectrum
ann <- read.delim(gzfile(params$annotation), colClasses = "character")
ann <- ann[!(as.integer(ann$pos) >= 8527 & as.integer(ann$pos) <= 8572), ]
syn_cls <- "synonymous"; non_cls <- c("missense", "stop_gained", "start_lost", "stop_lost")
pos_syn <- sum(ann$consequence %in% syn_cls); pos_non <- sum(ann$consequence %in% non_cls)
hc <- hv[!is.na(hv$consequence) & !(as.integer(hv$pos) >= 8527 & as.integer(hv$pos) <= 8572), ]
dn <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c("low", "high", "all"), function(b) {
  x <- if (b == "all") hc else hc[hc$hf_bin == b, ]
  o_non <- sum(x$consequence %in% non_cls); o_syn <- sum(x$consequence %in% syn_cls)
  data.frame(HF_bin = b, nonsynonymous = o_non, synonymous = o_syn,
             crude_dNdS = if (o_syn > 0) signif((o_non / pos_non) / (o_syn / pos_syn), 3) else NA)
}))
cat("Crude dN/dS: (observed / possible) nonsynonymous over synonymous heteroplasmic SNVs,",
    "possible SNVs from the rCRS annotation, MT-ATP8/ATP6 overlap (8527-8572) excluded;",
    "not weighted by the mutation spectrum, so use it to compare groups, not as an absolute value.\n\n")
print(kable(dn, row.names = FALSE))
gc <- as.data.frame(table(gene = hc$gene[hc$consequence %in% non_cls]))
if (nrow(gc)) print(kable(gc[order(-gc$Freq), ], row.names = FALSE, col.names = c("gene", "nonsynonymous heteroplasmies")))
```

```{r subtype-setup, include = FALSE}
run_subtype <- !is.na(subtype) && nlevels(droplevels(a[[subtype]])) >= 2
if (run_subtype) {
  zz <- z[match(a$sample, z$sample), readouts, drop = FALSE]
  keep <- complete.cases(zz) & !is.na(a[[subtype]])
  X <- as.matrix(zz[keep, , drop = FALSE]); rownames(X) <- a$sample[keep]
  y <- droplevels(a[[subtype]][keep])
  run_subtype <- nrow(X) >= 6 && nlevels(y) >= 2
}
ari <- function(x, y) {  # adjusted Rand index
  tab <- table(x, y); c2 <- function(n) n * (n - 1) / 2
  s <- sum(c2(tab)); a <- sum(c2(rowSums(tab))); b <- sum(c2(colSums(tab))); e <- a * b / c2(sum(tab))
  if ((a + b) / 2 == e) return(NA); (s - e) / ((a + b) / 2 - e)
}
auc <- function(score, pos) {  # Mann-Whitney AUC
  r <- rank(score); n1 <- sum(pos); n0 <- sum(!pos)
  if (!n1 || !n0) return(NA); (sum(r[pos]) - n1 * (n1 + 1) / 2) / (n1 * n0)
}
```

```{r clustering, eval = run_subtype}
km <- kmeans(X, centers = k, nstart = 50)$cluster
hc <- cutree(hclust(dist(X), method = "ward.D2"), k = k)
kable(data.frame(method = c("k-means", "hierarchical (Ward)"), k = k,

      caption = "Agreement of clusters with subtypes (adjusted Rand index: 1 = identical, ~0 = chance)")
```

### Supervised (elastic net, nested cross-validation)

```{r glmnet, eval = run_subtype, results = "asis"}
strat_folds <- function(y, k) {  # stratified fold ids
  f <- integer(length(y))
  for (lv in levels(droplevels(y))) { i <- which(y == lv); f[i] <- sample(rep_len(seq_len(k), length(i))) }
  f
}
if (!has_glmnet) {
  cat("glmnet is not installed; supervised analysis skipped.\n")
} else if (min(table(y)) < 4) {
  cat(sprintf("Supervised analysis skipped: nested cross-validation needs at least 4 samples per subtype after QC (smallest: %d).\n", min(table(y))))
} else {
  K <- min(5, min(table(y)))
  folds <- strat_folds(y, K)
  fam <- if (nlevels(y) == 2) "binomial" else "multinomial"
  prob <- matrix(NA_real_, length(y), nlevels(y), dimnames = list(rownames(X), levels(y)))
  sel <- matrix(0, ncol(X), nlevels(y), dimnames = list(colnames(X), levels(y)))
  for (f in seq_len(K)) {
    tr <- folds != f; te <- !tr
    ytr <- droplevels(y[tr])
    nf <- min(5, min(table(ytr)))   # >= 3 since every subtype has >= 4 samples
    cv <- suppressWarnings(glmnet::cv.glmnet(X[tr, , drop = FALSE], ytr, family = fam, alpha = 0.5,
                                             foldid = strat_folds(ytr, nf), grouped = FALSE))
    p <- predict(cv, X[te, , drop = FALSE], s = "lambda.min", type = "response")
    prob[te, ] <- if (fam == "binomial") cbind(1 - as.numeric(p), as.numeric(p)) else p[, , 1]
    cf <- coef(cv, s = "lambda.min")
    if (fam == "binomial") sel[, 2] <- sel[, 2] + (as.numeric(cf[-1]) != 0)
    else for (lv in levels(y)) sel[, lv] <- sel[, lv] + (as.numeric(cf[[lv]][-1]) != 0)
  }
  pred <- factor(levels(y)[max.col(prob, ties.method = "first")], levels = levels(y))
  cat(sprintf("%s model, alpha = 0.5; outer %d-fold CV and inner CV for lambda, both stratified by subtype.\n\n",
              fam, K))
  aucs <- vapply(levels(y), function(lv) auc(prob[, lv], y == lv), numeric(1))
  print(kable(data.frame(subtype = levels(y), n = as.integer(table(y)), AUC_one_vs_rest = round(aucs, 3)),
              row.names = FALSE, caption = sprintf("Out-of-fold AUC; overall accuracy %.2f", mean(pred == y))))
  print(kable(table(observed = y, predicted = pred), caption = "Confusion matrix (out-of-fold)"))
  full <- suppressWarnings(glmnet::cv.glmnet(X, y, family = fam, alpha = 0.5,
                                             foldid = strat_folds(y, K), grouped = FALSE))
  cf <- coef(full, s = "lambda.min")
  coefs <- if (fam == "binomial") matrix(as.numeric(cf[-1]), ncol = 1, dimnames = list(colnames(X), levels(y)[2]))
           else sapply(levels(y), function(lv) as.numeric(cf[[lv]][-1]))
  rownames(coefs) <- colnames(X)
  print(kable(round(coefs, 3), caption = "Coefficients, model on all samples (lambda.min; z-scored readouts)"))
  stab <- if (fam == "binomial") sel[, 2, drop = FALSE] else sel
  print(kable(stab / K, digits = 2, caption = sprintf("Selection frequency across the %d outer folds", K)))
}
```
